newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy reform commission to elect leaders Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Italy reform commission to elect leaders Wednesday.

text.p: Italy's newly-formed reform commission will meet on Wednesday for the first time and elect a president, Chamber of Deputies (lower house) president Luciano Violante said on Tuesday.
Violante said the parliamentary commission, made up of 70 members of the Chamber and Senate (upper house), would also elect three vice-presidents and four secretaries.
The new commission, which was given final parliamentary approval on January 22, has until June 30 to draft a package of proposed constiutional reforms to give Italy a more stable government.
The proposals will have to be approved individually by two-thirds of each house otherwise, they must go to a popular referendum.
